problem: With the prior single-loop patch applied, an elevated DXF MPOLYGON imports its polyline paths at Z=0; multiple polyline HATCH loops save at group-30 elevation zero. The generated two-loop HATCH and MPOLYGON regression failed 54 assertions in each codec build before this patch.

authority.title: Autodesk HATCH DXF group codes
authority.scope: HATCH and MPOLYGON have a shared OCS elevation field and extrusion direction; this patch only maps default-normal DXF MPOLYGON input and flat default-normal polyline output.

patch.base: Apply after docs/patches/librecad3-p8-hatch-planar-elevation-2026-11-19.patch on its reconstructed candidate; it is not standalone on upstream master.
patch.reconstruction: Replayed the three ordered MPOLYGON patches, selected PR #456 paths, legacy and import-loss patches, ABI-3 integration, and lineweight patches on LibreCAD_3 upstream 4fb48312708b39d499f7e6668104a3b54a8601c7; the adapter preimage matched Git blob e56db6b9bdd3910f570f34d0db4f1b5fce6c6179 before applying the previous elevation patch. Dependency archives use the pinned revisions listed in p8-librecad3-05e7-patched-persistence-load-2026-11-18.json.
patch.application: Apply check PASS against isolated preimages; applying produces byte-identical tested adapter and test source. No user consumer checkout modified.
patch.changes: Map the entity elevation into DXF MPOLYGON polyline vertex Z for the default normal. Emit a common HATCH elevation only if every loop has exactly one closed, nonempty default-normal polyline with zero polyline elevation/thickness and every vertex has the same finite Z. If a checked ordinary HATCH has mixed or nonfinite vertex elevation, record a loss note. Existing MPOLYGON fallback loss reporting remains. DWG MPOLYGON import and tilted planes are unchanged.

tests.focused: PASS 4/4 on each codec: new locally generated elevated two-loop HATCH and MPOLYGON imports, ASCII/Binary save/reopen and resave/reopen, mixed-loop loss note/no fabricated elevation and corrected same-document retry; plus previous single-loop elevation, simple MPOLYGON and rotation/bulge controls.
tests.line: PASS 2/2 on each codec: 2D LINE open/save and 3D LINE save/reopen. The 2D case does not reopen saved output.
tests.independent: ezdxf 1.4.5 reads 12 generated outputs per codec, checks HATCH type, AC1015, both loop vertex lists, default extrusion, shared elevation 3 for normal and retry cases, elevation 0 for mixed fallback, and ASCII/Binary signatures. Mixed geometry is still flattened and explicitly reported as loss.
tests.releaseInventory: 1351 released files; generator check and 18-control self-test PASS. No DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.

limits: The downstream patch stack is unmerged; native GUI, rendering, producer DWG, full application, and Linux/Windows behavior are not qualified.

Only default-normal DXF MPOLYGON polyline input and flat default-normal closed polyline loops are newly handled. Mixed/nonfinite elevation, tilted planes, edge paths, nonzero polyline elevation/thickness and other geometry are not preserved by this change. The ordinary HATCH loss note covers mixed/nonfinite Z detected during the checked polyline traversal; it does not claim detection of every unsupported path.
MPOLYGON-to-HATCH fallback still loses subtype-specific data and keeps its loss note. The conservative nondefault-plane import note remains.
Generated files and scratch logs are ephemeral and were not committed. P8-D remains open.
